##### Project general facts

Samana Portside emerges as a landmark development that signals long-horizon developer conviction, offering convertible one and two-bedroom homes with private pools in one of Dubai's most strategically positioned corridors. This exceptional project by Samana, a pioneer of residential plunge pools and one of the fifth-largest off-plan developers in Dubai, brings together turn-key solutions, premium international brands, and a quality ecosystem that spans design, engineering, construction, and community management. With over fifty projects launched to date across fourteen locations throughout Dubai, Samana brings its proven expertise and uncompromising commitment to excellence to this exciting new address.

The residences at Samana Portside are thoughtfully designed to deliver exceptional value and lifestyle, with convertible layouts that adapt to changing needs and a flexible payment plan that makes homeownership remarkably accessible. Each residence features premium finishes, contemporary design, and the signature private plunge pools that have become a hallmark of Samana's commitment to resort-inspired living. The interiors are crafted with meticulous attention to detail, creating spaces that are both elegant and functional, where every element has been considered to enhance comfort and wellbeing.

Beyond the exquisite homes, Samana Portside offers an impressive array of amenities that elevate everyday living to new heights of relaxation and recreation. Residents enjoy a spectacular pool deck, outdoor amenities designed for social connection and leisure, and a fully equipped indoor gym that supports an active and health-conscious lifestyle. The development's comprehensive approach to community living ensures that every need is anticipated, from the elegant reception area to the thoughtfully designed communal spaces that foster a true sense of belonging.

##### Location description and benefits  

Downtown Jebel Ali offers an unparalleled location that places residents at the heart of one of Dubai's most dynamic and rapidly evolving districts, with seamless connectivity to the city's most prestigious destinations and beyond. This thriving area provides immediate access to the Dubai Metro's uninterrupted Red Line service, ensuring effortless travel to key districts including Dubai Marina, JLT, and the city centre. The neighbourhood's strategic position, with entry price per square foot still significantly below surrounding communities, represents an extraordinary opportunity for both homeowners and investors seeking exceptional value.

Life within Downtown Jebel Ali is defined by its remarkable accessibility to employment hubs, with thousands of international tenant companies feeding a robust resident and rental base that continues to grow. The neighbourhood benefits from its proximity to Jebel Ali's business district, home to over one hundred Fortune 500 companies including global leaders in FMCG, automotive, industrial, technology, and logistics sectors. World-class healthcare facilities, including Aster Cedars Hospital and NMC Royal Hospital, along with the pristine Jebel Ali Beach and the iconic Palm Jebel Ali, ensure that every convenience and leisure pursuit is always within easy reach.

The surroundings of Downtown Jebel Ali offer exceptional connectivity to Dubai's most significant landmarks, with Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City, and the Etihad Rail network all seamlessly accessible. The area's established infrastructure and ongoing development, including the Imtiaz Raw District, signal a long-term commitment to growth and prosperity that benefits all who call this neighbourhood home. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining exceptional connectivity and employment proximity with a lifestyle of comfort, convenience, and remarkable value.
